label: Context-window detection: status output promising what the real path refuses

origin.note: The commit whose review produced this repo’s signature defect class. Its fix (1ea398f) claims 13 confirmed defects but enumerates six, so most of that count is not recoverable as labels.

defects.description: canDelegate takes defaultModel entirely on trust and calls any non-empty candidate list usable, so setup reports "Ready" where a task refuses — a named embedder, a configured model absent from the server, or two chat models it will not choose between.

Records from two endpoints are joined on the raw id, so an id spelled differently on one side (a quantization suffix) misses the lookup and spreads undefined, dropping the model’s type. An untyped record passes the embeddings denylist trivially.
